# ClearMoon.llc

> Clear Moon is a full-spectrum managed service provider (MSP) delivering enterprise IT, cybersecurity, AI solutions, networking, cloud services, VoIP & unified communications, and compliance services nationwide from Miami, Florida.

## Services

- **Managed IT Services & 24/7 Help Desk** — Flat-rate managed IT with SLA-backed 15-minute response times, proactive monitoring, patch management, vendor coordination, vCIO strategy, and hardware lifecycle management.
- **Cybersecurity & NOC/SOC** — 24/7 security operations center, threat detection and response, SIEM/SOAR, endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), penetration testing, vulnerability management, and security awareness training.
- **AI Solutions & Integration** — RAG-based AI portals, intelligent document processing, predictive analytics, custom LLM deployments, AI-powered workflow automation, and responsible AI consulting.
- **Enterprise Networking & Wi-Fi** — High-density wireless (Wi-Fi 6/6E), SD-WAN, zero-trust network access, structured cabling, network design, and multi-site deployments for hospitality and enterprise.
- **Cloud Services & Migration** — Multi-cloud management (AWS, Azure, GCP), hybrid infrastructure, disaster recovery, cloud cost optimization, and zero-downtime migration planning.
- **VoIP & Unified Communications (UCaaS)** — Microsoft Teams Voice, SIP trunking, hosted PBX, contact center solutions, conference room A/V, and phone system deployment.
- **Compliance Services** — Assessment and remediation for HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, CMMC, and NIST frameworks. Gap analysis, policy development, audit preparation, and continuous compliance monitoring.

## Industries Served

- Hospitality (Hotels, Resorts, Convention Centers)
- Healthcare (Clinics, Medical Offices, Telehealth)
- Logistics & Distribution
- Professional Services (Law Firms, Accounting, Consulting)
- Multi-Site Retail
- Education (K-12, Higher Education)
- Government & Public Sector
